title: Half-Life
description: Blending action and adventure with award-winning technology, creating a frighteningly realistic world.
lore: Theoretical physicist Gordon Freeman must fight his way out of a secret research facility after an experiment goes horribly wrong.

title: Counter-Strike: Source
description: Counter-Strike: Source blends Counter-Strike's award-winning teamplay action with Source technology.
lore: Tactical counter-terrorism round-based shooter featuring classic maps like de_dust2.

title: Team Fortress Classic
description: One of the most popular online action games of all time set in team-based combat.
lore: Classic class-based multiplayer action from early Valve history.

title: DayZ
description: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic country where a new and miraculous virus has turned the global population into infected?
lore: Scavenge, craft, and survive against infected and ruthless players in the sprawling fictional nation of Chernarus.

title: Project Zomboid
description: Project Zomboid is an open-ended zombie infestation sandbox. Alone or in multiplayer: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish.
lore: Kentucky has fallen to a mysterious zombie plague. You must survive as long as possible against relentless undead hordes.

title: 7 Days to Die
description: An open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games.
lore: Survive a brutal post-apocalyptic world destroyed by nuclear terror, preparing your base for the terrifying Blood Moon horde.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
description: A randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy rogue-like elements.
lore: Isaac flees his mother into a basement dungeon filled with grotesque monsters, religious relics, and bizarre power-ups.

title: Enter the Gungeon
description: A bullet hell dungeon crawler following a ragtag band of gunnies seeking absolution.
lore: Shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip your way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary gun that can kill the past.

title: Vampire Survivors
description: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn in this gothic horror casual game.
lore: The evil entity Death has sent endless hordes of monsters. You must survive and level up weapons automatically.

title: Balatro
description: A poker-themed roguelike deck builder all about crafting illegal poker hands and breaking the game.
lore: Play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping combos.

title: Dave the Diver
description: A casual singleplayer adventure game featuring deep-sea exploration and sushi restaurant management.
lore: Explore the mysterious Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.

title: Octopath Traveler II
description: The latest installment in the HD-2D visual style franchise, taking role-playing games to new heights.
lore: Eight travelers journey across Solistia, each with their own origins, talents, and personal motivations.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: The timeless RPG classic from Square Enix featuring legendary character designs by Akira Toriyama.
lore: A group of adventurers journey through time across prehistory, the Middle Ages, the present, and a bleak future to save the world.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: The legendary role-playing game that redefined the genre, now on PC.
lore: Eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE fights against the megalithic Shinra Electric Power Company draining the planet's life energy.

title: Final Fantasy XIV Online
description: Take part in an ever-expanding epic FINAL FANTASY adventure across Eorzea.
lore: Warriors of Light unite to battle Garlean legions, Ascians, and primal deities threatening the realm.

title: Guild Wars 2
description: A renowned MMORPG featuring fast-paced action combat and dynamic open-world events.
lore: Defend Tyria from awakening Elder Dragons and mythological threats in an immersive fantasy universe.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online
description: Experience an award-winning online RPG set in the legendary Elder Scrolls universe.
lore: Join friends or journey solo across Tamriel in an era before Skyrim, fighting daedric princes and factions.

title: Lost Ark
description: Embark on an odyssey for the Lost Ark in a vast, vibrant world.
lore: Explore new lands, seek out lost treasures, and test yourself in thrilling action combat.

title: Black Desert
description: Experience the fast-paced, action-packed combat and gorgeous graphics of Black Desert.
lore: An open-world fantasy MMORPG featuring breathtaking graphics, skill-based combat, and siege warfare.

title: RuneScape
description: A fantasy MMORPG shaped by its community with regular updates and deep quests.
lore: Explore Gielinor, train skills, defeat bosses, and forge your own legend.

title: Old School RuneScape
description: The classic, nostalgic version of RuneScape loved by millions worldwide.
lore: Old-school point-and-click MMORPG adventures across the world of Gielinor.

title: The Sims 4
description: Play with life and discover the possibilities in The Sims 4 life simulation game.
lore: Create and customize unique Sims, build dream homes, and guide their lives and careers.

title: Slime Rancher
description: Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky, young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light-years away.
lore: Collect bouncy alien slimes, build corrals, cultivate crops, and explore the Far, Far Range.

title: Slime Rancher 2
description: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys to Rainbow Island.
lore: Discover ancient technologies, vibrant new slimes, and colorful mysteries on a mysterious island.

title: House Flipper
description: House Flipper is a unique chance to become a one-man renovation crew.
lore: Buy, repair, and remodel devastated houses to flip them for a handsome profit.

title: PowerWash Simulator
description: Release the pressure with PowerWash Simulator! Wash away your worries with high-pressure jets of water.
lore: Clean vehicles, buildings, and parks across Muckingham to restore sparkling cleanliness.

title: Viscera Cleanup Detail
description: Sci-fi horror is a messy business. Step into the boots of a space-station janitor.
lore: Clean up the blood, guts, and bullet casings left behind after a heroic sci-fi massacre.

title: Cooking Simulator
description: Become the ultimate chef! Take control of a highly polished, realistic kitchen.
lore: Master dozens of recipes and realistic kitchen physics in a fast-paced restaurant simulation.

title: Thief Simulator
description: Become a real thief. Steal in neighborhood houses, fence goods, and buy gear.
lore: Observe targets, gather intel, and break into wealthy suburban homes without getting caught.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
description: Build and expand your repair service empire in this highly detailed simulation game.
lore: Repair, paint, tune, and test drive cars in a fully equipped mechanic garage.

title: Farm Simulator 22
description: Take on the role of a modern farmer and creatively build your farm in three diverse American and European environments.
lore: Grow crops, breed animals, manage forestry, and run seasonal farming operations.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 2
description: The much-anticipated sequel to Frontier's highly successful Jurassic World Evolution.
lore: Build your own Jurassic World park, bioengineer new dinosaur species, and handle containment crises.

title: Two Point Hospital
description: Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage your troublesome staff.
lore: Build quirky hospitals curing fictitious diseases like Light-headedness and Cubic Pains.

title: Two Point Campus
description: Build the university of your dreams with the creators of Two Point Hospital.
lore: Construct academic campuses offering wild courses like Knight School and Gastronomy.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Complete Edition
description: The classic roller coaster park simulation with fully rendered 3D graphics.
lore: Build wild roller coasters, manage park finances, and delight virtual park guests.

title: Broforce
description: An action-packed run-n-gun platformer celebrating freedom and explosive firepower.
lore: A financially underfunded paramilitary organization deals exclusively in overwhelming force.

title: Hotline Miami
description: Hotline Miami is a high-octane action game overflowing with raw brutality, hard-boiled gunplay and skull-crushing close combat.
lore: Set in an alternative 1989 Miami, you answer cryptic answering machine messages directing you to massacre Russian mobsters.

title: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number
description: The brutal conclusion to the Hotline Miami saga following conflicting factions.
lore: Factions of imitators, cops, and killers clash in a psychedelic spiral of violence and tragedy.

title: Katana Zero
description: A stylish neo-noir, cyberpunk action platformer featuring lightning-fast combat.
lore: Slash, dash, and manipulate time as an elite assassin uncovering his forgotten past in a neon city.

title: Super Meat Boy
description: A tough as nails platformer where you are a animated cube of meat who tries to save his girlfriend.
lore: Dr. Fetus has kidnapped Bandage Girl, and Meat Boy must dash through hundreds of lethal hazards.

title: Cuphead
description: A classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles inspired by 1930s cartoons.
lore: Cuphead and Mugman gamble their souls away to the Devil and must collect debts across Inkwell Isle.

title: Blasphemous
description: A brutal action-platformer with skilled hack-n-slash combat set in the nightmare world of Cvstodia.
lore: The Sole Penitent known as The Penitent One wanders a twisted religious land cursed by a dark miracle.

title: Blasphemous 2
description: The Penitent One awakens once more in the thrilling sequel to Blasphemous.
lore: Continue the endless battle against the Miracle in a perilous new non-linear world.

title: Salt and Sanctuary
description: Seamlessly combines fast, brutal, and complex 2D combat with rich RPG mechanics.
lore: Shipwrecked on a mysterious uncharted island filled with grotesque monsters and forgotten creeds.

title: Axiom Verge
description: A love letter to 8-bit and 16-bit classics like Metroid and Contra.
lore: After a lab accident, scientist Trace awakens in an ancient, surreal alien labyrinth.

title: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
description: A sweeping classic action adventure game with awesome gameplay, memorable characters, and 8-bit retro aesthetic.
lore: Shovel Knight wields his Shovel Blade to defeat the Order of No Quarter and rescue Shield Knight.

title: Undertale
description: The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.
lore: A human child falls underground into a magical monster realm where every battle can be resolved through peaceful dialogue.

title: Deltarune
description: The sequel to Undertale set in a parallel story by Toby Fox.
lore: Kris and Susie tumble into a dark realm where monsters and dark fountains threaten reality.

title: OMORI
genre: RPG, Psychological Horror, Indie, Story Rich
description: Explore a strange world full of colorful friends and foes in this acclaimed psychological horror RPG.
lore: Traverse between two worlds to uncover forgotten memories and confront deep psychological trauma.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
description: Welcome to a terrifying world of poetry and romance.
lore: Join the school literature club, write poems for cute girls, and unravel dark psychological secrets.

title: To the Moon
description: A story-driven RPG about two doctors traversing through a dying man's memories to fulfill his last wish.
lore: Johnny's dying wish is to go to the moon, though he cannot remember why.

title: A Way Out
description: A co-op only adventure where you play as one of two prisoners breaking out of jail.
lore: Leo and Vincent must forge an unlikely alliance to break out of prison and protect their families.

title: Detroit: Become Human
genre: Adventure, Sci-Fi, Story Rich, Choices Matter
description: Enter a near-future Detroit where machines have become more intelligent than humans.
lore: Follow three distinct androids—Kara, Connor, and Markus—as they awaken with human emotions and spark a revolution.

title: Heavy Rain
genre: Adventure, Mystery, Story Rich, Choices Matter
description: Experience a tense psychological thriller spanning four days of mystery and murder.
lore: Four characters track down the Origami Killer, a serial killer who drowns victims in rainwater.

title: Beyond: Two Souls
description: A unique psychological action thriller starring Hollywood actors Ellen Page and Willem Dafoe.
lore: Jodie Holmes possesses a supernatural link to a mysterious entity named Aiden, taking her across a life of danger.

title: Life is Strange - Episode 1
genre: Adventure, Story Rich, Choices Matter, Casual
description: An episodic adventure game that allows the player to rewind time and affect the past, present and future.
lore: Max Caulfield discovers she can rewind time while saving her childhood friend Chloe Price in Arcadia Bay.

title: Life is Strange 2
description: A tragic accident forces two brothers on the run across America pursued by the police.
lore: Sean and Daniel Diaz flee their Seattle home after a sudden supernatural tragedy triggers telekinetic powers.

title: Firewatch
description: A mystery set in the Wyoming wilderness, where your only emotional lifeline is the person on the other end of a handheld radio.
lore: Fire lookout Henry investigates strange occurrences in Shoshone National Forest while talking to supervisor Delilah.

title: The Stanley Parable
description: You will play as Stanley, and you will not play as Stanley. A first-person exploration game.
lore: An omniscient narrator guides your choices while you rebel against his scripted narration in an office building.

title: The Vanishing of Ethan Carter
description: A story-driven mystery game focused on exploration and discovery.
lore: An occult detective investigates the disappearance of a young boy in a picturesque Wisconsin valley.

title: What Remains of Edith Finch
description: A collection of strange tales about a family in Washington state.
lore: Edith Finch explores her eccentric family's massive estate, reliving the surreal final moments of each doomed relative.

title: SOMA
genre: Sci-Fi, Survival Horror, Atmospheric, Story Rich
description: A sci-fi horror game from Frictional Games, creators of Amnesia.
lore: Awakening in an underwater research facility in the year 2104, Simon Jarrett questions what it means to be human.

title: Layers of Fear
description: A first-person psychological horror game focused heavily on story and exploration.
lore: A mad painter descends into utter insanity within his Victorian mansion while trying to complete his masterpiece.

title: Little Nightmares
description: Immerse yourself in Little Nightmares, a dark whimsical tale that will confront your childhood fears.
lore: Six tries to escape the Maw, a massive iron vessel inhabited by grotesque corrupted guests.

title: Little Nightmares II
description: Return to a world of charming horror in Little Nightmares II, a suspenseful adventure game.
lore: Mono, a young boy trapped in a distorted world, teams up with Six to uncover dark tower secrets.
